_readme: Manifest for the pre-made story assets in G:\Meu Drive\Agência BEEF MTK\Clientes\Bernadino restaurante\STORIES\Brenda - Stories. Each entry: file (relative to that folder), category (salgado|salada|doce), weekday (segunda|terca|quarta|quinta|sexta|null=generic, any day), type (image|video), used, used_at. Built 2026-07-27 by visually inspecting every file (baked-in text determines weekday, not filename). Excluded: '23_07 (2).png' (broken - raw phone camera UI screenshot, not a finished asset). Deduplicated: 'BERNARDINO RESTAURANTE.png' (=TERÇA - GERAL.png), 'BERNARDINO RESTAURANTE (1).png' (=56.png), 'BERNARDINO RESTAURANTE (3).png' (=57.png), 'BERNARDINO RESTAURANTEgg.png' and '24_07 (3).png' (=24_07.png) were dropped as exact duplicates of a kept file.
